name: Jay Scutti Plaza
summary: Jay Scutti Plaza is a neighborhood strip center on Hylan Drive in Rochester, offering convenient access to retail and services for the local community. With extended hours and a solid community reputation, it serves as a practical shopping destination for southeastern Rochester residents.
demographics: Jay Scutti Plaza serves the southeastern Rochester suburban market, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area draws from households with moderate to above-average incomes who value convenience shopping for everyday needs and services. Typical visitors include local residents seeking quick shopping trips, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees who appreciate the accessible strip center format and ample parking.
description: Jay Scutti Plaza is a convenient neighborhood shopping destination located on Hylan Drive in Rochester, New York, serving the local community with essential retail and service offerings. This strip center provides residents of southeastern Rochester with easy access to everyday shopping needs in a straightforward, accessible format. With extended operating hours from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM, the plaza accommodates busy schedules and offers flexibility for shoppers throughout the day. The center maintains a solid reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.2-star rating from nearly 2,000 customer reviews. Situated in a residential area of Rochester, Jay Scutti Plaza exemplifies the traditional neighborhood shopping center model, providing convenient parking and ground-level access to its various retail and service tenants.
